{{Quote|I thought you were out in Atrivis sector, baby-sitting the Outer Rim comm center.''"<br />"''You're behind the times, Generis fell three days ago.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] and Pash Cracken|<ref name="LC" />}}
The '''fall of Generis''' occurred in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] as part of the [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]] of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] to recapture the galaxy for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="LC" />

==Battle==
[[Generis/Legends|Generis]] was home to the [[Outer Rim Communications Center]], of distinct strategic importance. As such, [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] [[Gender/Legends|himself]] planned the assault and sent a force composed of his new [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] forces. The combination of superior forces and planning ensured victory for the Imperials over the New Republic forces, which included an elite Republic squadron commanded by [[Pash Cracken/Legends|Pash Cracken]]. The Imperials won the Communications Center largely intact, as well as gaining control of most of the [[Atrivis Sector Force|sector fleet]] supply depots.<ref name="LC" />

In their retreat, the Republic forces were able to sneak out [[Travia Chan/Legends|Travia Chan]] and her command staff, and deny the Imperials any working ships, but nevertheless suffered an important defeat.<ref name="LC" />

Imperial stormtrooper [[Grodin Tierce]] was known to have died in the battle.<ref name="VotF" />
